project.title: Dream Box
project.tagline: The room remembers what you forgot.
project.description: A first-person surrealist exploration game set entirely within a single room — the inside of someone's mind, infected by digital noise. The room transforms around you using dream logic as you interact with corrupted domestic objects.

members.name: Kasper Crittenden-Wedge
members.Blurb: Kasper is an aspiring game developer with a strong interest in gameplay design, particularly systems and gameplay economies. Alongside this, he is a qualified football referee in Kent, with both disciplines shaping his ambition to create or contribute to football games that rival the best in the genre. Outside of projects and football, his interests include the Warhammer universe, history, golf, and a variety of other sports to name a few.

Favourite Drink.Drink Name: Tea, one sugar and a splash of milk

members.name: Shannon Grant
members.Blurb: Hi, I’m Shannon, a final-year game development student with a strong passion for both programming and game design. I enjoy creating and building things, whether that’s developing gameplay systems, designing player experiences, or working hands-on with hardware. I also love playing all types of games, which helps inspire my design thinking and understanding of different player experiences. Outside of games, my interests include building PCs, creating art, and collecting Pokémon cards all reflecting my love for creativity, problem-solving, and playful design.

members.name: Patryk Parzelski
members.Blurb: Patryk is a 3D artist with a strong passion for level design and animation, driven by a love for making worlds and visuals that are immersive. Especially inspired by narrative-driven games like The Last of Us (part 2 being my all-time favourite game IN GENERAL) and the stylised creativity of Borderlands: TPS. Constantly looking to optimise his workflows and experiment with new styles, he's recently expanded into drawing as well as trying out concept art, including contributing concepts for a ROBLOX game project.

Game 1.Game Name: The Last of Us Part II

members.name: D'Arcy Everitt

members.name: Davide Motta
members.Blurb: My name is Davide, and I am a student at the Faculty of Game Design at the University of Greenwich, specialising in 3D animation and modelling for video games. In my free time, I practise Taekwondo, enjoy playing video games, and eating well.

Patryk Parzelski.Blurb: Patryk has always been interested in gaming, constantly playing varying genres of games to get a taste of them all. Ivan Ivanov Kapitanski.Blurb: Ivan is an avid gamer and metalhead with a lifelong passion for programming, and an aspiring games developer. There is no programming task that he can't solve both quickly and efficiently, whether solo or as part of a team.

Josh Gorton.Blurb: Josh is a game designer and programmer who studied at the University of Greenwich. He also cooks part-time.
